provenance.generation_note: The card is text. The program is a hand-written parameterisation of the command sequence the S1C0 agent produced; no learned policy is involved.

retrieval.description: Pick the single upright cup and place it on the tray floor, released and settled.

failure_exits.condition: palm above tray floor + 0.12 m when the hand opens
failure_exits.recovery: lower in <=5 cm steps, then open

failure_exits.condition: hand closes or palm drops below tray floor + 0.10 m after release
failure_exits.recovery: retreat and finish; the episode ends at release

failure_exits.condition: one plain move exceeds 0.05 m of palm travel
the target palm pose is outside the arm workspace
failure_exits.recovery: move nearer, or change waist pitch and re-probe

notes: tray inner half-extent [0.214, 0.054] m, cup radius 0.041 m, so the placement band is +/-0.013 m in y
waist pitch -0.10 rad is required for the approach to stay reachable

card.text: Reach the cup in five phases, a few short commands each. 1) Clear: lift the palm to about (-0.07, 0.34, 0.09) keeping the current wrist orientation, then raise it to (-0.04, 0.34, 0.30) with a level palm. Each leg is several moves of at most 5 cm; one long move drifts the base. 2) Lean: set waist_pitch_joint to about -0.10 rad, wait 1 s, and move back to the clear pose; without this lean the approach stops about 20 cm short. 3) Approach: the grasp pose is cup_bottoms_m minus the rotated cup_in_palm_m from grasp_probe; start from approach_start_xyz_m and walk to grasp_xyz_m in steps of 2-3 cm, keeping the palm yaw. 4) Close: set the thumb to 0.0/0.65/0.65 rad and index and middle to -0.8/-0.6 rad, wait, then lift in 3-5 cm steps to 12 cm and check that the cup stayed with the hand. 5) Place: use place_probe, not the tray centre. Move the palm to place_probe.above_xyz_m with the same palm yaw, then lower to place_probe.lower_xyz_m; that puts the cup bottom at place_probe.cup_bottom_at_lower_m over the tray centre. Aiming the palm at the tray centre leaves the cup one cup_in_palm away and it lands beside the tray. Do not open the hand before the palm is at or below place_probe.release_palm_below_z_m; releasing higher is refused as RELEASE_TOO_HIGH and the cup topples. Open the hand fully, wait 0.5 s without moving, then retreat upward in 5 cm steps and call finish. The episode ends at release: touching or re-grasping the cup afterwards is refused as REAPPROACH_AFTER_RELEASE. Let the scene settle for at least 1 s before finishing. No single move may exceed 5 cm of palm travel; longer moves are rejected, so split them. Use 2 s or more per move; a large jump in one command trips tracking protection. If grasp_xyz_m is rejected, change waist_pitch_joint by 0.05 rad, wait, and read grasp_probe again. If a probe reports POSE_IK_REJECTED, move nearer before retrying. Never infer successful placement from a completed motion.

program.acceptance_note: Accepted on control_2500: verified, stable 7.20 s, 51 commands, verdict hash unchanged from _013.

criteria.general_generator_note: TP03 cups sit 0.65-1.06 m from the registered pelvis; the left arm reaches 0.45 m forward.

limits: Validated on one saved initial state; the paired result is 0/4 vs 3/4.
Fresh-seed replication with the current program: 8/16 (position 1/4, orientation 3/4, asset 3/4, joint 1/4).
Three independent seed blocks give 9/16, 8/16 and 8/16; widening yaw from 2 to 6 did not help.
The waist sweep removed every GRASP_UNREACHABLE failure (5 in repl2, 0 in repl3), but the pass count did not move.
The remaining failures are placement near-misses: 6 of 8 land within 6.4 mm of the 1 mm margin and lean 6-12 deg on the rim.
Correcting the placement further is not validated; the 2-3 mm perception bias is the same order as the gap.
Lowering the release height from 3.0 cm to 1.5 cm failed its own control acceptance (-1.6 mm, 8.6 deg) and was reverted; the artifact is byte-identical to v9.
The general generator's TP03 template is out of scope for a stationary single arm: 0/18 table cells sit inside the 0.45 m forward reach.
n=4 per arm; one-sided Fisher exact p = 0.071, so the paired difference is suggestive, not significant.

promotion.rule: A record becomes validated only when the card is paired-validated and the program passes its own acceptance run on the same saved state.
blocking: n=4 per arm; Wilson lower bound 0.30
placement margin 2.7-9.6 mm inside a 13 mm band
